Sandboxes bundles no third-party viewer code. Its desktop viewer is served by
voxl, which the sandbox image builds from source.

voxl 0.3.3 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/tembo/voxl/tree/v0.3.3
Source package: https://crates.io/crates/voxl-server/0.3.3

The image builds voxl with `cargo install voxl-server --locked`. Its license and
the Cargo.lock that lists every statically linked Rust crate are installed at
/usr/share/doc/voxl in the image.

voxl links these Debian bookworm shared libraries at run time:

    libx264-164   x264        GPL-2.0-or-later
    libyuv0       libyuv      BSD-3-Clause
    libopus0      Opus        BSD-3-Clause
    libpulse0     PulseAudio  LGPL-2.1-or-later

Because voxl links x264, the voxl program in the image is distributed under the
terms of the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later. Its complete
corresponding source is the voxl source above, the Dockerfile in this package,
and the Debian source packages, which `apt-get source x264 libyuv opus
pulseaudio` retrieves on bookworm. Each library's Debian copyright file is in
/usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright in the image.
